description: Checks another agent's answer to your challenge: signed with the key named in its mandate, for that challenge and mandate, within 5 minutes. It proves the agent holds the key; it does not check the mandate itself (use symbolon_check_counterparty). Read-only.

for.description: Your own agent key, if you gave it to the other agent: then the answer must name it

mandate.description: The mandate the other agent showed you

name: symbolon_check_possession
title: Check a proof of key
